report_id.description: Stable id for this report (UUID recommended).

host_id.description: Stable host identity label (not necessarily secret); may be derived from a device identity attestation or provisioning record.

hw_inventory_digest.description: Digest pointer to a hardware inventory receipt (e.g., spec/hw.inventory.receipt.schema.json).

fw_inventory_digest.description: Digest pointer to a firmware inventory receipt or inventory object (e.g., spec/fw.inventory.receipt.schema.json or spec/fw.device.inventory.schema.json).

boot_attestation_digest.description: Digest pointer to a boot attestation / boot health report / verifier receipt (optional lane).

uefi_vars_digest.description: Digest pointer to a blob artifact containing selected UEFI variables (policy-controlled).

hardware_summary.description: Optional, privacy-safe summary facts for quick triage (prefer digests to raw dumps).

firmware_summary.description: Optional summary of platform firmware state (prefer digests to raw dumps).

evidence.description: Optional digest pointers to supporting evidence objects (logs, verifier receipts, dumps).
